title: Ascites: Definition, Epidemiology & SAAG Classification
guide: Master the classification of peritoneal fluid by SAAG and total protein, distinguishing portal hypertensive from peritoneal causes.

title: Pathophysiology & Ascitic Fluid Characterization
guide: Understand the splanchnic vasodilation cascade leading to fluid retention and distinguish chylous from pseudochylous ascites.

title: Clinical Examination, Paracentesis & Medical Grading
guide: Apply anatomical landmarks for paracentesis, fluid detection thresholds, and graded step-up therapy from salt restriction to diuretics.

title: Spontaneous Bacterial Peritonitis: Criteria & Clinical Variants
guide: Identify diagnostic cutoffs for SBP and distinguish CNNA and MNNA variants based on neutrophil counts and microbiology.

title: Management, Surgical Peritonitis & SBP Prophylaxis
guide: Differentiate surgical peritonitis from SBP, apply empirical cefotaxime regimens, and determine indications for norfloxacin prophylaxis.

title: Refractory Ascites: Subtypes & Procedural Interventions
guide: Distinguish diuretic-resistant from diuretic-intractable ascites and identify indications for TIPSS.

title: Hepatorenal Syndrome: Pathophysiology, Diagnosis & Management
guide: Follow the vasoconstrictive progression from splanchnic dilation to renal failure, apply diagnostic exclusion criteria, and institute terlipressin bridge therapy.

title: Hepatopulmonary Syndrome: Pulmonary Vascular Complications
guide: Recognize nitric oxide-driven intrapulmonary capillary dilatation, platypnea-orthodeoxia, bubble echocardiography findings, and definitive liver transplantation.
